title: Above the Law
text: When you score this agenda, you may trash 1 installed resource. Limit 1 per deck.

title: AMAZE Amusements
text: Persistent -> Whenever a run on this server ends, if the Runner stole any agendas during that run, give the Runner 2 tags. (If the Runner trashes this card while accessing it, this ability still applies for the remainder of this run.)

title: Anoetic Void
text: Whenever the Runner approaches this server, you may pay 2 credits and trash 2 cards from HQ. If you do, end the run.

title: Ansel 1.0
text: Lose click: Break 1 subroutine on this ice. Only the Runner can use this ability. Subroutine Trash 1 installed Runner card. Subroutine You may install 1 card from HQ or Archives. Subroutine The Runner cannot steal or trash Corp cards for the remainder of this run.

title: Ballista
text: Subroutine Trash 1 installed program or end the run.

title: Botulus
text: Install only on a piece of ice. (If the host ice is uninstalled, this program is trashed.) When you install this program and when your turn begins, place 1 virus counter on this program. Hosted virus counter: Break 1 subroutine on host ice.

title: Brân 1.0
text: Lose click: Break 1 subroutine on this ice. Only the Runner can use this ability. Subroutine You may install 1 piece of ice from HQ or Archives directly inward from this ice, ignoring all costs. Subroutine End the run. Subroutine End the run.

title: Buzzsaw
text: Interface -> 1 credit: Break up to 2 code gate subroutines. 3 credits: +1 strength.

title: Carmen
text: If you made a successful run this turn, this program costs 2 credits less to install. Interface -> 1 credit: Break 1 sentry subroutine. 2 credits: +3 strength.

title: Carnivore
text: +1 mu Access, once per turn -> Trash 2 cards from your grip: Trash the card you are accessing. Limit 1 console per player.

title: Clearinghouse
text: You can advance this asset. When your turn begins, you may trash this asset to do 1 meat damage for each hosted advancement counter.

title: Cleaver
text: Interface -> 1 credit: Break up to 2 barrier subroutines. 2 credits: +1 strength.

title: Conduit
text: Whenever a successful run on R&D ends, you may place 1 virus counter on this program. click: Run R&D. If successful, access X additional cards when you breach R&D. X is equal to the number of hosted virus counters.

title: Cookbook
text: Whenever you install a virus program, you may place 1 virus counter on it.

title: Creative Commission
text: Gain 5 credits. If you have any click remaining, lose click.

title: Diviner
text: Subroutine Do 1 net damage. If you trash a card this way with a printed play or install cost that is an odd number, end the run. (0 is not odd.)

title: Docklands Pass
text: The first time each turn you breach HQ, access 1 additional card.

title: DZMZ Optimizer
text: +1 mu The first program you install each turn costs 1 credit less to install.

title: Echelon
text: This program gets +1 strength for each installed icebreaker (including this one). Interface -> 1 credit: Break 1 sentry subroutine. 3 credits: +2 strength.

title: Fermenter
text: When you install this program and when your turn begins, place 1 virus counter on this program. click, trash: Gain 2 credits for each hosted virus counter.

title: Funhouse
text: When the Runner encounters this ice, end the run unless the Runner takes 1 tag. Subroutine Give the Runner 1 tag unless they pay 4 credits.

title: Government Subsidy
text: Gain 15 credits.

title: Haas-Bioroid: Precision Design
text: You get +1 maximum hand size. Whenever you score an agenda, you may add 1 card from Archives to HQ.

title: Hansei Review
text: Gain 10 credits. If there are any cards in HQ, trash 1 of them.

title: Hedge Fund
text: Gain 9 credits.

title: Jailbreak
text: Run HQ or R&D. If successful, draw 1 card and when you breach the attacked server, access 1 additional card.

title: Jinteki: Restoring Humanity
text: When your discard phase ends, if there is a facedown card in Archives, gain 1 credit.

title: Karunā
text: Subroutine Do 2 net damage. The Runner may jack out. Subroutine Do 2 net damage.

title: Leech
text: Whenever you make a successful run on a central server, place 1 virus counter on this program. Hosted virus counter: The ice you are encountering gets -1 strength for the remainder of this encounter.

title: Longevity Serum
text: When you score this agenda, trash any number of cards from HQ. Shuffle up to 3 cards from Archives into R&D. Limit 1 per deck.

title: Luminal Transubstantiation
text: When you score this agenda, gain click click click. You cannot score agendas for the remainder of the turn. Limit 1 per deck.

title: Malapert Data Vault
text: Whenever you score an agenda from the root of this server, you may search R&D for 1 non-agenda card and reveal it. (Shuffle R&D after searching it.) Add that card to HQ.

title: Manegarm Skunkworks
text: Whenever the Runner approaches this server, end the run unless they either spend click click or pay 5 credits.

title: Marjanah
text: Interface -> 2 credits: Break 1 barrier subroutine. If you made a successful run this turn, this ability costs 1 credit less to use. 1 credit: +1 strength.

title: Mayfly
text: Interface -> 1 credit: Break 1 subroutine. When this run ends, trash this program. 1 credit: +1 strength.

title: Mutual Favor
text: Search your stack for 1 icebreaker and reveal it. (Shuffle your stack after searching it.) If you made a successful run this turn, you may install that program. If you do not, add it to your grip.

title: NBN: Reality Plus
text: The first time each turn the Runner takes a tag, gain 2 credits or draw 2 cards.

title: Neurospike
text: Do X net damage, where X is equal to the sum of the printed agenda points on agendas you scored this turn.

title: Nico Campaign
text: When you rez this asset, load 9 credits onto it. When it is empty, trash it and draw 1 card. When your turn begins, take 3 credits from this asset.

title: Offworld Office
text: When you score this agenda, gain 7 credits.

title: Orbital Superiority
text: When you score this agenda, if the Runner is tagged, do 4 meat damage; otherwise, give the Runner 1 tag.

title: Overclock
text: Place 5 credits on this event, then run any server. You can spend hosted credits during that run.

title: Palisade
text: While this ice is protecting a remote server, it gets +2 strength. Subroutine End the run.

title: Pantograph
text: +1 mu Whenever an agenda is scored or stolen, gain 1 credit. Then, you may install 1 card from your grip. Limit 1 console per player.

title: Pennyshaver
text: +1 mu Whenever you make a successful run, place 1 credit on this hardware. click: Place 1 credit on this hardware, then take all credits from it. Limit 1 console per player.

title: Pharos
text: You can advance this ice. It gets +5 strength while there are 3 or more hosted advancement counters. Subroutine Give the Runner 1 tag. Subroutine End the run. Subroutine End the run.

title: Ping
text: When you rez this ice during a run against this server, give the Runner 1 tag. Subroutine End the run.

title: Predictive Planogram
text: Resolve 1 of the following. If the Runner is tagged, you may resolve both instead. * Gain 3 credits. * Draw 3 cards.

title: Public Trail
text: Play only if the Runner made a successful run during their last turn. Give the Runner 1 tag unless they pay 8 credits.

title: Red Team
text: When you install this resource, load 12 credits onto it. When it is empty, trash it. click: Run a central server you have not run this turn. If successful, take 3 credits from this resource.

title: Regolith Mining License
text: When you rez this asset, load 15 credits onto it. When it is empty, trash it. click: Take 3 credits from this asset.

title: René “Loup” Arcemont: Party Animal
text: The first time each turn you trash a card you are accessing, gain 1 credit and draw 1 card.

title: Retribution
text: Play only if the Runner is tagged. Trash 1 installed program or piece of hardware.

title: Seamless Launch
text: Place 2 advancement counters on 1 installed card that you did not install this turn.

title: Send a Message
text: When this agenda is scored or stolen, you may rez 1 installed piece of ice, ignoring all costs.

title: Smartware Distributor
text: click: Place 3 credits on this resource. When your turn begins, take 1 credit from this resource.

title: Spin Doctor
text: When you rez this asset, draw 2 cards. Remove this asset from the game: Shuffle up to 2 cards from Archives into R&D.

title: Sprint
text: Draw 3 cards. Shuffle 2 cards from HQ into R&D.

title: Superconducting Hub
text: When you score this agenda, you may draw 2 cards. You get +2 maximum hand size.

title: Sure Gamble
text: Gain 9 credits.

title: T400 Memory Diamond
text: +1 mu You get +1 maximum hand size.

title: Tāo Salonga: Telepresence Magician
text: Whenever an agenda is scored or stolen, you may swap 2 installed pieces of ice.

title: Telework Contract
text: When you install this resource, load 9[credit] onto it. When it is empty, trash it. Once per turn -> click: Take 3[credit] from this resource.

title: The Catalyst: Convention Breaker
text: Starter game only.

title: The Syndicate: Profit over Principle
text: Starter game only.

title: Tithe
text: Subroutine Do 1 net damage. Subroutine Gain 1 credit.

title: Tomorrowʼs Headline
text: When this agenda is scored or stolen, give the Runner 1 tag. Limit 1 per deck.

title: Tranquilizer
text: Install only on a piece of ice. (If the host ice is uninstalled, this program is trashed.) When you install this program and when your turn begins, place 1 virus counter on this program. Then, if there are 3 or more hosted virus counters, derez host ice.

title: Tread Lightly
text: Run any server. During that run, the rez cost of each piece of ice is increased by 3 credits.

title: Unity
text: Interface -> 1 credit: Break 1 code gate subroutine. 1 credit: +X strength. X is equal to the number of installed icebreakers (including this one).

title: Urtica Cipher
text: You can advance this asset. When the Runner accesses this asset while it is installed, do 2 net damage plus 1 net damage for each hosted advancement counter.

title: Verbal Plasticity
text: The first time each turn you take the basic action to draw 1 card, instead draw 2 cards.

title: VRcation
text: Draw 4 cards. If you have any click remaining, lose click.

title: Weyland Consortium: Built to Last
text: Whenever you advance a card, gain 2 credits if it had no advancement counters.

title: Whitespace
text: Subroutine The Runner loses 3 credits. Subroutine If the Runner has 6 credits or less, end the run.

title: Wildcat Strike
text: Resolve 1 of the following of the Corp's choice: * Gain 6 credits. * Draw 4 cards.

title: Zahya Sadeghi: Versatile Smuggler
text: Once per turn -> When a run on HQ or R&D ends, you may gain 1[credit] for each time you accessed a card during that run.
